title: Adjustable-Rate Terms Schedule, Rural Home Loans
content:
Schedule of adjustable-rate terms for the Rural Home Loans products. Only the Country Home 5/6 Adjustable and the Country Home 7/6 Adjustable carry adjustable-rate terms; every term below is 0 for the fixed products.

## Terms defined

- **Margin** — percentage points added to the index at each adjustment; 0 for fixed products.
- **Index look-back** — the index value used is the latest one published at least this many days before the change date; 0 for fixed products.
- **First adjustment cap** — most the rate may move at the first adjustment, percentage points; 0 for fixed products.
- **Subsequent adjustment cap** — most the rate may move at each later adjustment, percentage points; 0 for fixed products.
- **Lifetime cap** — most the rate may ever exceed the initial rate, percentage points; 0 for fixed products.
- **Adjustment interval** — months between adjustments after the first; 0 for fixed products.
- **Rate floor** — lowest note rate after any adjustment (the margin for adjustable products), annual percent; 0 for fixed products.

## Schedule

| Product | Margin (points) | Index look-back (days) | First adjustment cap (points) | Subsequent adjustment cap (points) | Lifetime cap (points) | Adjustment interval (months) | Rate floor (annual percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 2.75 | 45 | 2.0 | 1.0 | 5.0 | 6 | 2.75 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 2.75 | 45 | 5.0 | 1.0 | 5.0 | 6 | 2.75 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The two adjustable products differ only in the first adjustment cap: 2.0 points on the Country Home 5/6 Adjustable and 5.0 points on the Country Home 7/6 Adjustable; their later caps, lifetime cap, interval, look-back, margin and floor are the same.
2. On both adjustable products the rate floor of 2.75 percent equals the margin of 2.75 points.
3. *Hypothetical illustration of the lifetime cap:* a Country Home 5/6 Adjustable loan whose initial rate was 5.75 percent may never carry a note rate above 5.75 plus 5.0, that is 10.75 percent.
